description: An unknown rootId is a typed refusal (ErrInboxScope, -31926), never an empty list: an empty inbox would read as 'nothing needs you', which is how a typo makes the attention plane lie. The id the caller sent rides in data.what. S58 T2 opened the -31923...-31929 block (after S47's reservation comment claimed -31914...-31922).
